title: dryopteris expansa var. alpina
intro: Dryopteris expansa var. alpina, commonly known as Mountain Male Fern, is a type of fern native to the mountainous regions of Europe and Asia. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing relief from various health issues, including its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Male Fern include its ability to reduce pain and inflammation, making it a potential treatment for conditions such as arthritis. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its antioxidant and antimicrobial properties.
